root_causes.description: The recommendation pod exhibits a severe CPU stress condition: container CPU usage climbed to ~3.6 cores (mean 2.34 cores) during the incident window, far above the sub-core baseline typical for this service. All other fault signals are clean (error rate 0.0, zero pod restarts, stable ~105-109MB memory, p99 latency ~24ms), isolating the root cause to abnormal CPU consumption inside the recommendation container rather than crashes, memory pressure, or downstream dependency failures.

evidence.expected_baseline: cpu_usage < 0.5 cores for recommendation service under normal load
error_rate < 0.01; zero errors rules out http_abort
pod_restarts=0; zero restarts rules out pod_crash/OOMKill

evidence.observed_value: memory_usage mean=105861666 bytes (~101MB), max=108965888 bytes (~104MB), flat throughout window
evidence.expected_baseline: stable ~100MB working set; no growth trend rules out memory_stress
p99 < 100ms; normal latency rules out high_latency and dependency_failure on product-catalog

remediation_steps: Inspect processes inside the recommendation pod (kubectl exec -n otel-demo <recommendation-pod> -- top) to identify and kill the CPU-stress/rogue process consuming ~3.6 cores
Restart the recommendation deployment (kubectl rollout restart deployment/recommendation -n otel-demo) to clear the stress condition if a rogue process is confirmed
Verify and enforce CPU resource limits/requests on the recommendation container and consider horizontal autoscaling to absorb abnormal CPU load
Add a Prometheus alert on sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="otel-demo",pod=~"recommendation-.*"}[2m])) > 1.0 for early detection of CPU stress recurrence
